E waste is a major source of toxic pollution, and its management is an important environmental and public health issue, especially in developing countries.

E waste generation and management are a global concern that requires urgent attention from all countries, developed and developing, in order to prevent pollution, protect the environment, and ensure human health.
WEEE is a major environmental issue in terms of pollution and public health threats.

the global flows of E waste, the environmental and health threats associated with the improper management of E waste, and the development of sustainable WEEE management systems.
